Ukiyo-e is a unique craft that developed in Japan, and it is an art that is highly regarded worldwide.
Production proceeds through a division of roles among the painter, the carver and the printer.
It goes through a complex process in which the carver carves the preliminary drawing made by the painter into a woodblock, and the printer prints it onto paper.
Especially in the case of multicolour printing, it is necessary to use a different woodblock for each colour, so the advanced skill and cooperation of the craftsmen are indispensable.
In this way, a single picture is completed.
